# Two-photon TDSE campaign, runs 2-6: summary (11 Oct 2026)

Full rows: run{2..6}/results.csv (extract_runs.py). Peaks: |E - E_c| < 0.25 eV of the iSurff spectrum. P_proj_corr = 1 - bound
(OccDual, Re E < 0) minus the no-field drift. All runs exit 0.
